coordination_holds_append: D-078 replaces the separate 3.00 m Side A workstation window, 0.20 m junction and 4.30 m provisional main glazing with one 7.20 × 2.90 m modular opening centred at X=15.75 m in the 10.50 m monumental band.
The 5.40 × 0.90 m Side A worktop is centred within the opening and provides two 1.65 m clear knee/chair bays between three 0.70 m suspended three-drawer steel cabinet units.

The Side B 3.00 × 0.90 m single workstation and its 3.00 × 1.65 m window remain unchanged; D-078 deliberately ends the strict D-068/D-069 workstation mirror because the two sides now serve different interior programmes.

Exterior appearance does not drive D-078. The Side A opening and envelope must prioritize ruggedness, weather resistance, drainage, replaceable standard parts, safe glazing, thermal performance, maintainability and whole-life cost.

The 7.20 m opening removes the predecessor 0.20 m trimmer reservation but does not remove the need for a professionally designed header, jambs, longitudinal stability path, facade rails, seals, flashings and low-eave drainage.
Final mullion positions must avoid primary monitor sightlines; workstation loads remain on dedicated secondary steel and may not be assigned to glazing frames or unverified facade girts.
